_meta.source: cooked EA assets F:/MSEAroot/legacy/MainSequence/Content + EA paks (BPO_* Default objects, CUE4Parse CLI); demo-era entries kept when EA colliders + BlockBounds identical
_meta.units: Colliders are PNum (int32/65536) sim units; 1 block cell = 16 units; block-local frame origin at block centre; stored X/Y axes vs site axes NOT verified. Z: wall 0..2, lintel 2.5..4.5. Mesh bounds in Unreal uu half extents.
_meta.floor_rule: No readable floor-size property: FactoryFloorComponent has NO reflected properties (only SetupFactoryFloor); the BPC_FactoryFloor object in the actor holds only AttachParent + relative transform. Buildable rect is native. floor_rect_inferred = hull minus wall thickness; matches user-verified sizes for all 5 known blocks.

status_legend.inferred: derived rule that matches known cases
